Your holdings: SMCI (-28.46%), SOXL (-67.47%), and SPAL (-42.9%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the S&P 500's technical levels. AMD's jump on earnings is a positive sign for the chip sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your significant losses in leveraged ETFs and deeply underwater chip names.
plays: Trim SMCI: The stock is down nearly 30% and below its stop. Consider reducing exposure.
Trim SOXL: Down over 67%, this leveraged ETF is a major drag. Consider trimming to manage risk.
Trim SPAL: Down over 42%, this leveraged ETF is also a significant loss. Consider trimming.
